title: 幕后的幕后  (A Producer Stays Behind the Scenes)

segments.t: Back in his office, Chun Yuqiao refuses to fight the media scandal, warning his team that provoking Xin Huimei's massive fanbase would ruin the upcoming live finale.
辛惠美有多少粉丝？
微博粉丝嘛，大概两千多万。在艺人里面，不算是最多的。
粉丝最重要的是质量，而不是数量。
一旦发生事情，他们的凝聚力和行动力，是你们想象不到的。
决赛直播之前，不要节外生枝。
您都快被脏水淹死了，您怎么决赛直播啊？
不行，这事必须澄清。
我不是艺人，我不需要炒作，我也不需要澄清。
我是一个专业的制作人，是幕后，幕后的幕后。
永远不要给我作秀。
Kaiwen wants to clarify the truth publicly, but Chun Yuqiao has a different philosophy.
辛惠美有多少粉丝？
Chun Yuqiao warns against provoking Xin Huimei. He asks how many "fensi" or 'fans' she has.
微博粉丝嘛，大概两千多万。在艺人里面，不算是最多的。
Kaiwen replies that she has "liangqianduowan" or 'over twenty million' fans on Weibo, which is not the most among artists.
粉丝最重要的是质量，而不是数量。
Chun Yuqiao explains that the most important thing is "zhiliang" or 'quality', not quantity.
一旦发生事情，他们的凝聚力和行动力，是你们想象不到的。
He warns that their "ningjuli" or 'cohesion' is beyond imagination when a crisis happens.
决赛直播之前，不要节外生枝。
He uses the idiom "jie wai sheng zhi" which means 'to cause extra trouble'. He wants to avoid this before the live broadcast.
您都快被脏水淹死了，您怎么决赛直播啊？
Kaiwen protests that Chun Yuqiao is drowning in "zangshui" or 'dirty water', meaning false accusations.
不行，这事必须澄清。
Kaiwen insists that they must "chengqing" or 'clarify' the truth.
我不是艺人，我不需要炒作，我也不需要澄清。
Chun Yuqiao refuses. He is not an "yiren" or 'artist', and does not need "chaozuo" or 'hype'.
我是一个专业的制作人，是幕后，幕后的幕后。
He proudly declares himself a professional producer who stays "muhou", which is the word for 'behind the scenes'.
永远不要给我作秀。
He ends the argument by telling them never to "zuoxiu" or 'put on a show' for him. Let us listen to his principles again.
辛惠美有多少粉丝？
微博粉丝嘛，大概两千多万。在艺人里面，不算是最多的。
粉丝最重要的是质量，而不是数量。
一旦发生事情，他们的凝聚力和行动力，是你们想象不到的。
决赛直播之前，不要节外生枝。
您都快被脏水淹死了，您怎么决赛直播啊？
不行，这事必须澄清。
我不是艺人，我不需要炒作，我也不需要澄清。
我是一个专业的制作人，是幕后，幕后的幕后。
永远不要给我作秀。

Chun Yuqiao refuses to lower himself to internet drama, choosing to protect his show above all else. You learned how to say "fensi" for "fans", the word for "hype", and the idiom for "causing extra trouble". See you next time!
下次见！
